verses.original: נִדְרַ֙שְׁתִּי֙ לְל֣וֹא שָׁאָ֔לוּ נִמְצֵ֖אתִי לְלֹ֣א בִקְשֻׁ֑נִי אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ הִנֵּ֣נִי הִנֵּ֔נִי אֶל־ גּ֖וֹי לֹֽא־ קֹרָ֥א בִשְׁמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: niḏ·raš·tî lə·lō·w šā·’ā·lū nim·ṣê·ṯî lə·lō ḇiq·šu·nî ’ā·mar·tî hin·nê·nî hin·nê·nî ’el- gō·w lō- qō·rā ḇiš·mî
verses.literal: I revealed Myself to those who did not ask for Me I was found by those who did not seek Me To a nation that did not call My name I said Here I am Here I am
verses.literalPt: FUI buscado dos que não perguntavam por mim, fui achado daqueles que não me buscavam; a uma nação que não se chamava do meu nome eu disse: Eis-me aqui. Eis-me aqui.

verses.original: פֵּרַ֧שְׂתִּי יָדַ֛י כָּל־ הַיּ֖וֹם אֶל־ עַ֣ם סוֹרֵ֑ר הַהֹלְכִים֙ הַדֶּ֣רֶךְ לֹא־ ט֔וֹב אַחַ֖ר מַחְשְׁבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: pê·raś·tî yā·ḏay kāl- hay·yō·wm ’el- ‘am sō·w·rêr ha·hō·lə·ḵîm had·de·reḵ lō- ṭō·wḇ ’a·ḥar maḥ·šə·ḇō·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: All day long . . . I have held out My hands to an obstinate people who walk in the wrong . . . path who follow their own imaginations
verses.literalPt: Estendi as minhas mãos o dia todo a um povo rebelde, que anda por caminho, que não é bom, após os seus pensamentos;

verses.original: הָעָ֗ם הַמַּכְעִיסִ֥ים אוֹתִ֛י עַל־ פָּנַ֖י תָּמִ֑יד זֹֽבְחִים֙ בַּגַּנּ֔וֹת וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים עַל־ הַלְּבֵנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ām ham·maḵ·‘î·sîm ’ō·w·ṯî ‘al- pā·nay tā·mîḏ zō·ḇə·ḥîm bag·gan·nō·wṯ ū·mə·qaṭ·ṭə·rîm ‘al- hal·lə·ḇê·nîm
verses.literal: to a people who continually provoke Me to My face sacrificing in the gardens and burning incense on altars of brick
verses.literalPt: Povo que de contínuo me irrita diante da minha face, sacrificando em jardins e queimando incenso sobre altares de tijolos;

verses.original: הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בַּקְּבָרִ֔ים וּבַנְּצוּרִ֖ים יָלִ֑ינוּ הָאֹֽכְלִים֙ בְּשַׂ֣ר הַחֲזִ֔יר וּפְרַק פִּגֻּלִ֖ים כְּלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yō·šə·ḇîm baq·qə·ḇā·rîm ū·ḇan·nə·ṣū·rîm yā·lî·nū hā·’ō·ḵə·lîm bə·śar ha·ḥă·zîr ū·p̄ə·raq pig·gu·lîm kə·lê·hem
verses.literal: sitting among the graves spending nights in secret places eating the meat of pigs . . . and polluted broth from their bowls
verses.literalPt: Que habita entre as sepulturas, e passa as noites junto aos lugares secretos; come carne de porco e tem caldo de coisas abomináveis nos seus vasos;

verses.original: הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ קְרַ֣ב אֵלֶ֔יךָ אַל־ תִּגַּשׁ־ בִּ֖י כִּ֣י קְדַשְׁתִּ֑יךָ אֵ֚לֶּה עָשָׁ֣ן בְּאַפִּ֔י אֵ֥שׁ יֹקֶ֖דֶת כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·mə·rîm qə·raḇ ’ê·le·ḵā ’al- tig·gaš- bî kî qə·ḏaš·tî·ḵā ’êl·leh ‘ā·šān bə·’ap·pî ’êš yō·qe·ḏeṯ kāl- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: They say Keep to yourself do not come near me for I am holier than you Such people are smoke in My nostrils a fire that burns all day long . . .
verses.literalPt: Que dizem: Fica onde estás, e não te chegues a mim, porque sou mais santo do que tu. Estes são fumaça no meu nariz, um fogo que arde todo o dia.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה כְתוּבָ֖ה לְפָנָ֑י לֹ֤א אֶחֱשֶׂה֙ כִּ֣י אִם־ שִׁלַּ֔מְתִּי וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֖י עַל־ חֵיקָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ḵə·ṯū·ḇāh lə·p̄ā·nāy lō ’e·ḥĕ·śeh kî ’im- šil·lam·tî wə·šil·lam·tî ‘al- ḥê·qām
verses.literal: Behold it is written before Me I will not keep silent but . . . I will repay I will pay it back into their laps
verses.literalPt: Eis que está escrito diante de mim: não me calarei; mas eu pagarei, sim, pagarei no seu seio,

verses.original: עֲ֠וֺנֹתֵיכֶם וַעֲוֺנֹ֨ת אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֤ם יַחְדָּו֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר קִטְּרוּ֙ עַל־ הֶ֣הָרִ֔ים וְעַל־ הַגְּבָע֖וֹת חֵרְפ֑וּנִי וּמַדֹּתִ֧י פְעֻלָּתָ֛ם רִֽאשֹׁנָ֖ה עַל חֵיקָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·ḵem wa·‘ă·wō·nōṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem yaḥ·dāw ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ă·šer qiṭ·ṭə·rū ‘al- he·hā·rîm wə·‘al- hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ ḥê·rə·p̄ū·nî ū·mad·dō·ṯî p̄ə·‘ul·lā·ṯām ri·šō·nāh ʿal ḥê·qām
verses.literal: both for your iniquities and for those of your fathers says the LORD Because they burned incense on the mountains and scorned Me on the hills I will measure into their laps full payment for their former . . . deeds
verses.literalPt: As vossas iniqüidades, e juntamente as iniqüidades de vossos pais, diz o SENHOR, que queimaram incenso nos montes, e me afrontaram nos outeiros; assim lhes tornarei a medir as suas obras antigas no seu seio.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִמָּצֵ֤א הַתִּירוֹשׁ֙ בָּֽאֶשְׁכּ֔וֹל וְאָמַר֙ אַל־ תַּשְׁחִיתֵ֔הוּ כִּ֥י בְרָכָ֖ה בּ֑וֹ כֵּ֤ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ לְמַ֣עַן עֲבָדַ֔י לְבִלְתִּ֖י הַֽשְׁחִ֥ית הַכֹּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer yim·mā·ṣê hat·tî·rō·wōš bā·’eš·kō·wl wə·’ā·mar ’al- taš·ḥî·ṯê·hū kî ḇə·rā·ḵāh bōw kên ’e·‘ĕ·śeh lə·ma·‘an ‘ă·ḇā·ḏay lə·ḇil·tî haš·ḥîṯ hak·kōl
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says As the new wine is found in a cluster of grapes and men say Do not destroy it for it contains a blessing so I will act on behalf of My servants I will not destroy them all
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Como quando se acha mosto num cacho de uvas, dizem: Não o desperdices, pois há bênção nele, assim farei por amor de meus servos, que não os destrua a todos,

verses.original: וְהוֹצֵאתִ֤י מִֽיַּעֲקֹב֙ זֶ֔רַע וּמִיהוּדָ֖ה יוֹרֵ֣שׁ הָרָ֑י וִירֵשׁ֣וּהָ בְחִירַ֔י וַעֲבָדַ֖י יִשְׁכְּנוּ־ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ṣê·ṯî mî·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ze·ra‘ ū·mî·hū·ḏāh yō·w·rêš hā·rāy wî·rê·šū·hā ḇə·ḥî·ray wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏay yiš·kə·nū- šām·māh
verses.literal: And I will bring forth descendants from Jacob and heirs from Judah My elect will possess My mountains and My servants will dwell there
verses.literalPt: E produzirei descendência a Jacó, e a Judá um herdeiro que possua os meus montes; e os meus eleitos herdarão a terra e os meus servos habitarão ali.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה הַשָּׁרוֹן֙ לִנְוֵה־ צֹ֔אן וְעֵ֥מֶק עָכ֖וֹר לְרֵ֣בֶץ בָּקָ֑ר לְעַמִּ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר דְּרָשֽׁוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh haš·šā·rō·wn lin·wêh- ṣōn wə·‘ê·meq ‘ā·ḵō·wr lə·rê·ḇeṣ bā·qār lə·‘am·mî ’ă·šer də·rā·šū·nî
verses.literal: Sharon will become a pasture for flocks and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds for My people who seek Me
verses.literalPt: E Sarom servirá de curral de rebanhos, e o vale de Acor lugar de repouso de gados, para o meu povo, que me buscou.

verses.original: וְאַתֶּם֙ עֹזְבֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה הַשְּׁכֵחִ֖ים אֶת־ הַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֑י הַֽעֹרְכִ֤ים לַגַּד֙ שֻׁלְחָ֔ן וְהַֽמְמַלְאִ֖ים לַמְנִ֥י מִמְסָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem ‘ō·zə·ḇê Yah·weh haš·šə·ḵê·ḥîm ’eṯ- har qāḏ·šî ha·‘ō·rə·ḵîm lag·gaḏ šul·ḥān wə·ham·mal·’îm lam·nî mim·sāḵ
verses.literal: But you who forsake the LORD who forget My holy mountain who set a table for Fortune and fill bowls of mixed wine for Destiny
verses.literalPt: Mas a vós, os que vos apartais do SENHOR, os que vos esqueceis do meu santo monte, os que preparais uma mesa para a Fortuna, e que misturais a bebida para o Destino.

verses.original: וּמָנִ֨יתִי אֶתְכֶ֜ם לַחֶ֗רֶב וְכֻלְּכֶם֙ לַטֶּ֣בַח תִּכְרָ֔עוּ יַ֤עַן קָרָ֙אתִי֙ וְלֹ֣א עֲנִיתֶ֔ם דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וַתַּעֲשׂ֤וּ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י וּבַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ חָפַ֖צְתִּי בְּחַרְתֶּֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·nî·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem la·ḥe·reḇ wə·ḵul·lə·ḵem laṭ·ṭe·ḇaḥ tiḵ·rā·‘ū ya·‘an qā·rā·ṯî wə·lō ‘ă·nî·ṯem dib·bar·tî wə·lō šə·ma‘·tem wat·ta·‘ă·śū hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nay ū·ḇa·’ă·šer lō- ḥā·p̄aṣ·tî bə·ḥar·tem
verses.literal: I will destine you for the sword and you will all kneel down to be slaughtered because I called and you did not answer I spoke and you did not listen you did evil in My sight and chose that in which I did not delight
verses.literalPt: Também vos destinareis à espada, e todos vos encurvareis à matança; porquanto chamei, e não respondestes; falei, e não ouvistes; mas fizestes o que era mau aos meus olhos, e escolhestes aquilo em que não tinha prazer.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה עֲבָדַ֤י׀ יֹאכֵ֙לוּ֙ וְאַתֶּ֣ם תִּרְעָ֔בוּ הִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדַ֛י יִשְׁתּ֖וּ וְאַתֶּ֣ם תִּצְמָ֑אוּ הִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדַ֛י יִשְׂמָ֖חוּ וְאַתֶּ֥ם תֵּבֹֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nêh ‘ă·ḇā·ḏay yō·ḵê·lū wə·’at·tem tir·‘ā·ḇū hin·nêh ‘ă·ḇā·ḏay yiš·tū wə·’at·tem tiṣ·mā·’ū hin·nêh ‘ă·ḇā·ḏay yiś·mā·ḥū wə·’at·tem tê·ḇō·šū
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD . . . says My servants will eat but you will go hungry . . . My servants will drink but you will go thirsty . . . My servants will rejoice but you will be put to shame
verses.literalPt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que os meus servos comerão, mas vós padecereis fome; eis que os meus servos beberão, porém vós tereis sede; eis que os meus servos se alegrarão, mas vós vos envergonhareis;

verses.original: הִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדַ֛י יָרֹ֖נּוּ מִטּ֣וּב לֵ֑ב וְאַתֶּ֤ם תִּצְעֲקוּ֙ מִכְּאֵ֣ב לֵ֔ב וּמִשֵּׁ֥בֶר ר֖וּחַ תְּיֵלִֽילוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ‘ă·ḇā·ḏay yā·rōn·nū miṭ·ṭūḇ lêḇ wə·’at·tem tiṣ·‘ă·qū mik·kə·’êḇ lêḇ ū·miš·šê·ḇer rū·aḥ tə·yê·lî·lū
verses.literal: My servants will shout for joy with a glad heart but you will cry out with a heavy heart and wail with a broken spirit
verses.literalPt: Eis que os meus servos exultarão pela alegria de coração, mas vós gritareis pela tristeza de coração; e uivareis pelo quebrantamento de espírito.

verses.original: וְהִנַּחְתֶּ֨ם שִׁמְכֶ֤ם לִשְׁבוּעָה֙ לִבְחִירַ֔י וֶהֱמִיתְךָ֖ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה וְלַעֲבָדָ֥יו יִקְרָ֖א שֵׁ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·naḥ·tem šim·ḵem liš·ḇū·‘āh liḇ·ḥî·ray we·hĕ·mî·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw yiq·rā šêm ’a·ḥêr
verses.literal: You will leave behind your name as a curse for My chosen ones and the Lord GOD will slay you but to His servants He will give another name
verses.literalPt: E deixareis o vosso nome aos meus eleitos por maldição; e o Senhor DEUS vos matará; e a seus servos chamará por outro nome.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַמִּתְבָּרֵ֜ךְ בָּאָ֗רֶץ יִתְבָּרֵךְ֙ בֵּאלֹהֵ֣י אָמֵ֔ן וְהַנִּשְׁבָּ֣ע בָּאָ֔רֶץ יִשָּׁבַ֖ע בֵּאלֹהֵ֣י אָמֵ֑ן כִּ֣י נִשְׁכְּח֗וּ הַצָּרוֹת֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנ֔וֹת וְכִ֥י נִסְתְּר֖וּ מֵעֵינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ham·miṯ·bā·rêḵ bā·’ā·reṣ yiṯ·bā·rêḵ bê·lō·hê ’ā·mên wə·han·niš·bā‘ bā·’ā·reṣ yiš·šā·ḇa‘ bê·lō·hê ’ā·mên kî niš·kə·ḥū haṣ·ṣā·rō·wṯ hā·ri·šō·nō·wṯ wə·ḵî nis·tə·rū mê·‘ê·nāy
verses.literal: Whoever invokes a blessing in the land will do so by the God of truth and whoever takes an oath in the land will swear by the God of truth For the former . . . troubles will be forgotten and hidden from My sight
verses.literalPt: Assim que aquele que se bendisser na terra, se bendirá no Deus da verdade; e aquele que jurar na terra, jurará pelo Deus da verdade; porque já estão esquecidas as angústias passadas, e estão escondidas dos meus olhos.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנְנִ֥י בוֹרֵ֛א שָׁמַ֥יִם חֲדָשִׁ֖ים וָאָ֣רֶץ חֲדָשָׁ֑ה וְלֹ֤א תִזָּכַ֙רְנָה֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנ֔וֹת וְלֹ֥א תַעֲלֶ֖ינָה עַל־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hin·nî ḇō·w·rê šā·ma·yim ḥă·ḏā·šîm wā·’ā·reṣ ḥă·ḏā·šāh wə·lō ṯiz·zā·ḵar·nāh hā·ri·šō·nō·wṯ wə·lō ṯa·‘ă·le·nāh ‘al- lêḇ
verses.literal: For behold I will create new heavens and a new earth The former things will not be remembered nor will they come to mind
verses.literalPt: Porque, eis que eu crio novos céus e nova terra; e não haverá mais lembrança das coisas passadas, nem mais se recordarão.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אִם־ שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְגִ֙ילוּ֙ עֲדֵי־ עַ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנִ֣י בוֹרֵ֑א כִּי֩ הִנְנִ֨י בוֹרֵ֧א אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם גִּילָ֖ה וְעַמָּ֥הּ מָשֽׂוֹשׂ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’im- śî·śū wə·ḡî·lū ‘ă·ḏê- ‘aḏ ’ă·šer ’ă·nî ḇō·w·rê kî hin·nî ḇō·w·rê ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim gî·lāh wə·‘am·māh mā·śō·wś
verses.literal: But be glad and rejoice forever . . . in what I create for . . . I will create Jerusalem to be a joy and its people to be a delight . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas vós folgareis e exultareis perpetuamente no que eu crio; porque eis que crio para Jerusalém uma alegria, e para o seu povo gozo.

verses.original: וְגַלְתִּ֥י בִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְשַׂשְׂתִּ֣י בְעַמִּ֑י וְלֹֽא־ יִשָּׁמַ֥ע בָּהּ֙ ע֔וֹד ק֥וֹל בְּכִ֖י וְק֥וֹל זְעָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡal·tî ḇî·rū·šā·lim wə·śaś·tî ḇə·‘am·mî wə·lō- yiš·šā·ma‘ bāh ‘ō·wḏ qō·wl bə·ḵî wə·qō·wl zə·‘ā·qāh
verses.literal: I will rejoice in Jerusalem and take delight in My people The sounds of weeping . . . and crying will no longer be heard in her
verses.literalPt: E exultarei em Jerusalém, e me alegrarei no meu povo; e nunca mais se ouvirá nela voz de choro nem voz de clamor.

verses.original: לֹא־ יִֽהְיֶ֨ה מִשָּׁ֜ם ע֗וֹד ע֤וּל יָמִים֙ וְזָקֵ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יְמַלֵּ֖א אֶת־ יָמָ֑יו כִּ֣י הַנַּ֗עַר בֶּן־ מֵאָ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ יָמ֔וּת וְהַ֣חוֹטֶ֔א בֶּן־ מֵאָ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה יְקֻלָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yih·yeh miš·šām ‘ō·wḏ ‘ūl yā·mîm wə·zā·qên ’ă·šer lō- yə·mal·lê ’eṯ- yā·māw kî han·na·‘ar ben- mê·’āh šā·nāh yā·mūṯ wə·ha·ḥō·w·ṭe ben- mê·’āh šā·nāh yə·qul·lāl
verses.literal: No longer will a nursing infant live . . . but a few days or an old man fail to live out his years For the youth will die at a hundred years . . . and he who fails to reach a hundred . . . . . . will be considered accursed
verses.literalPt: Não haverá mais nela criança de poucos dias, nem velho que não cumpra os seus dias; porque o menino morrerá de cem anos; porém o pecador de cem anos será amaldiçoado.

verses.original: וּבָנ֥וּ בָתִּ֖ים וְיָשָׁ֑בוּ וְנָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְאָכְל֖וּ פִּרְיָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·nū ḇāt·tîm wə·yā·šā·ḇū wə·nā·ṭə·‘ū ḵə·rā·mîm wə·’ā·ḵə·lū pir·yām
verses.literal: They will build houses and dwell in them they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit
verses.literalPt: E edificarão casas, e as habitarão; e plantarão vinhas, e comerão o seu fruto.

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִבְנוּ֙ וְאַחֵ֣ר יֵשֵׁ֔ב לֹ֥א יִטְּע֖וּ וְאַחֵ֣ר יֹאכֵ֑ל כִּֽי־ כִימֵ֤י הָעֵץ֙ יְמֵ֣י עַמִּ֔י וּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיהֶ֖ם יְבַלּ֥וּ בְחִירָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lō yiḇ·nū wə·’a·ḥêr yê·šêḇ lō yiṭ·ṭə·‘ū wə·’a·ḥêr yō·ḵêl kî- ḵî·mê hā·‘êṣ yə·mê ‘am·mî ū·ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê·hem yə·ḇal·lū ḇə·ḥî·rāy
verses.literal: No longer will they build houses for others to inhabit nor plant for others to eat For as is the lifetime of a tree so will be the days of My people and My chosen ones will fully enjoy the work of their hands
verses.literalPt: Não edificarão para que outros habitem; não plantarão para que outros comam; porque os dias do meu povo serão como os dias da árvore, e os meus eleitos gozarão das obras das suas mãos.

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִֽיגְעוּ֙ לָרִ֔יק וְלֹ֥א יֵלְד֖וּ לַבֶּהָלָ֑ה כִּ֣י זֶ֜רַע בְּרוּכֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ הֵ֔מָּה וְצֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֖ם אִתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō yî·ḡə·‘ū lā·rîq wə·lō yê·lə·ḏū lab·be·hā·lāh kî ze·ra‘ bə·rū·ḵê Yah·weh hêm·māh wə·ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’ê·hem ’it·tām
verses.literal: They will not labor in vain or bear children doomed to disaster for they will be a people blessed by the LORD they and their descendants with them
verses.literalPt: Não trabalharão debalde, nem terão filhos para a perturbação; porque são a posteridade bendita do SENHOR, e os seus descendentes estarão com eles.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה טֶֽרֶם־ יִקְרָ֖אוּ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶעֱנֶ֑ה ע֛וֹד הֵ֥ם מְדַבְּרִ֖ים וַאֲנִ֥י אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ṭe·rem- yiq·rā·’ū wa·’ă·nî ’e·‘ĕ·neh ‘ō·wḏ hêm mə·ḏab·bə·rîm wa·’ă·nî ’eš·mā‘
verses.literal: Even before they call I will answer and while they are still speaking I will hear
verses.literalPt: E será que antes que clamem eu responderei; estando eles ainda falando, eu os ouvirei.

verses.original: זְאֵ֨ב וְטָלֶ֜ה יִרְע֣וּ כְאֶחָ֗ד וְאַרְיֵה֙ כַּבָּקָ֣ר יֹֽאכַל־ תֶּ֔בֶן וְנָחָ֖שׁ עָפָ֣ר לַחְמ֑וֹ לֹֽא־ יָרֵ֧עוּ וְלֹֽא־ יַשְׁחִ֛יתוּ בְּכָל־ הַ֥ר קָדְשִׁ֖י אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: zə·’êḇ wə·ṭā·leh yir·‘ū ḵə·’e·ḥāḏ wə·’ar·yêh kab·bā·qār yō·ḵal- te·ḇen wə·nā·ḥāš ‘ā·p̄ār laḥ·mōw lō- yā·rê·‘ū wə·lō- yaš·ḥî·ṯū bə·ḵāl har qāḏ·šî ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: The wolf and the lamb will feed together . . . and the lion will eat straw like the ox but the food of the serpent will be dust They will neither harm nor destroy on all My holy mountain says the LORD
verses.literalPt: O lobo e o cordeiro se apascentarão juntos, e o leão comerá palha como o boi; e pó será a comida da serpente. Não farão mal nem dano algum em todo o meu santo monte, diz o SENHOR.
